reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000986 (the melody read from 000986a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Peter Christian Lutkin's dates (1858–1931) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Lutkin_PC (Lutkin, Peter Christian, 1858-1931); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peter_Lutkin (March 27, 1858 - December 27, 1931) agrees; the same man as CCEH's 'Peter C. Lutkin'; CCEH's page gives only the year 1905. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000986a.nwc).
